title: Two Processes, One Disk
description:
Frontend alone is not enough. Ops wants a sidecar in the same Pod — log shipper or proxy — sharing an `emptyDir` so both sides can read/write the same files.

Keep **both** containers Ready. A lonely main container fails the pattern.

**Meant for:** Multi-container / sidecar pattern.

problemStatement.brief: Run Guestbook with a sidecar sharing an emptyDir (log shipper or proxy) — both containers Ready.
